We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. The Team The Numenor team is building Valar’s next reactor, the flagship program that will define how we deliver nuclear power at scale. This dedicated team owns the entire plant, from the reactor core and helium systems to cooling, plant modules, and the Citadel, uniting mechanical, systems, safety, IC&E, quality, and supply chain under one mission. The work starts with bringing the first unit to life and ends with a production line that delivers reactors faster with every build. What this team builds will power the critical infrastructure of the future. The Role Valar Atomics seeks an Engineering Manager for the reactor program. This role will build and lead a team of Responsible Engineers and designers for a group of mechanical systems, either the reactor side (reactor core and graphite, control rod drives, helium pressure boundary, heat transport, cavity cooling, and helium services) or the plant side (power conversion, heat rejection, the reactor complex and Citadel, service modules, and plant services). The role will lead the team from the first unit through scaled production, delivering reactors at an increasing rate. The role demands someone who leads engineers hands-on with a hardware-first mentality, owning people, schedule, and delivery, while the Responsible Engineers keep technical signature and ensure the design basis is met.
